0.name: TEXT_CMNDEFTEMPORARYBAG_00083_TALK_ACTOR_01
0.description: Well met, friend. I am in charge of storing property lost during the Calamity.
0.translation_description: <hex:02082BE905FF1342656E2074726F766174612C20616D696361FF1342656E2074726F7661746F2C20616D69636F03>. Mi occupo di custodire gli oggetti smarriti durante la Calamità.

1.name: TEXT_CMNDEFTEMPORARYBAG_00083_TALK_Q1
1.description: Are you here to reclaim your belongings?
1.translation_description: Sei qui per recuperare i tuoi effetti personali?

4.name: TEXT_CMNDEFTEMPORARYBAG_00083_TALK_A3
4.translation_description: No, non sono qui per quello.

5.name: TEXT_CMNDEFTEMPORARYBAG_00083_TALK_ACTOR_05
5.description: Countless souls went missing during the Calamity, and a veritable mountain of articles was left ownerless. The Adventurers' Guild has been holding such articles in safekeeping in hopes that their owners will one day reclaim them.
5.translation_description: Durante la Calamità, innumerevoli persone scomparvero e una vera montagna di oggetti rimase senza proprietario. La Gilda degli Avventurieri li custodisce con cura, nella speranza che un giorno i proprietari tornino a reclamarli.

6.name: TEXT_CMNDEFTEMPORARYBAG_00083_TALK_ACTOR_06
6.description: Please be warned, however, that we are <hex:021A020203>not<hex:021A020103> a storage service. The items you retrieve become your sole responsibility, and cannot be returned to us under any circumstance.
6.translation_description: Ti avverto però: <hex:021A020203>non<hex:021A020103> siamo un servizio di deposito. Gli oggetti che recuperi diventano di tua esclusiva responsabilità e non potrai restituirceli in nessun caso.

7.name: TEXT_CMNDEFTEMPORARYBAG_00083_TALK_ACTOR_10
7.description: Fewer folk come forward to reclaim their belongings with each passing day.

8.name: TEXT_CMNDEFTEMPORARYBAG_00083_TALK_ACTOR_11
8.description: It saddens me to think that some items will remain in our safekeeping forever, their owners never to return.
